title: An AVL tree
hints: Write one `rebalance(link)` that updates the node's height and applies whichever rotation case its balance needs, and call it on every node on the way back up, after both insertions and erasures.
For erasing a node with two children, a helper that **removes** the minimum of the right subtree and returns its key (rebalancing on its own way back up) keeps the main erase short.
